title: Conversation State Contradiction Eradication on Unrelated Turns
rootCause: state.intent assignment at line 214 replaces state.intent.contradictions with patch.contradictions, wiping unresolved contradictions from earlier turns when an unrelated prompt produces an empty contradictions patch.

title: Conversation Unit Correction Retains Stale Site Depth Unit
rootCause: Unit clarification patches spread existing site intent without clearing depthUnit, causing subsequent dimension evaluations to treat depth as the previous mixed unit.

title: Case-Sensitive Plural Room Name Matching Rejects Valid Updates
rootCause: allOfType uses name.endsWith('s') on raw regex match group without lowercasing, causing uppercase plural room names like BEDROOMS to evaluate to false and trigger ambiguity rejection.

title: Floor Count Reduction in Conversation Rejected Due to Stale Stair Requirement
rootCause: Reducing floors from 2 to 1 updates floors property but retains stair requirement object, triggering BlueprintRequirementsSchema superRefine stair restriction and surfacing as an unresolvable user conflict.

title: Package Script test:ifc Fails Due to Unbound Python Runtime
rootCause: package.json invokes global python3 which lacks ifcopenshell, while the validated ifcopenshell environment resides in /tmp/designflow-phase23-ifc.

title: Canonical Building Identity Ignores Stair Landing Ordering
rootCause: canonicalBuilding sorts top-level stairs by ID but leaves stair.landings in insertion order, producing divergent modelHash values for identical stairs and triggering BIM_SOURCE_MISMATCH.

title: Omitted Optional spaceIds Disconnects BIM and IFC Space Boundaries
rootCause: projectBim relies entirely on optional wall.spaceIds to emit bounds and accesses edges, generating zero IfcRelSpaceBoundary records when spaceIds is omitted.

title: Coincident Columns Bypass Invariants and QA to Contaminate Downstream Subsystems
rootCause: Neither invariants nor Blueprint QA checks for column-column collision or coincident duplication, allowing duplicate structural columns to double quantities and crash BIM projection.

title: Core Blueprint QA Overlooks Slab Voids Under Occupied Spaces
rootCause: slabsColumnsAudit tests space containment against slab outer boundary while ignoring slab voids, permitting unfloored open voids under habitable rooms to pass QA with zero errors.

title: BIM Core Rejects Valid Architectural Models Containing Columns
rootCause: Line 33 unconditionally rejects any model with m.columns.length > 0 as BIM_UNSUPPORTED_MODEL, creating an artificial incompatibility with BuildingModelV2.

title: Abandoned Message Lease Blocks Subsequent Conversation Interactions
rootCause: Route handler fails to wrap planConversation in try-finally to release conversation lease on failure, causing subsequent requests to fail with 409 MESSAGE_IN_PROGRESS for up to 60 seconds.

title: TOCTOU Race Condition in conversation_write('finish')
rootCause: Function snapshots project state prior to acquiring row lock on conversation, allowing proposal approval against a stale revision if project is concurrently updated.

title: Sentry Telemetry Drops All Phase 6–23 Routes and Engine Stack Frames
rootCause: sanitizeEvent route whitelist is restricted to Phase 5 paths and stack frame filter excludes packages/blueprint-qa, quantity-takeoff, construction-calculations, and boq-cost.

title: QA Core Slab Overlap Validation Fails to Detect Colliding Roof/Ceiling Solids
rootCause: Slab overlap check bypasses collision detection when non-floor slabs have differing top offsets, ignoring true 3D spatial intersections.

title: Multi-Mode Workflows Omit BIM Projection and IFC Generation Capabilities
rootCause: Workflow registry was not extended in Phase 23, leaving workflow orchestration disconnected from BIM and IFC capabilities.

title: Compute-Intensive Workflow Endpoint Excluded From Generate Rate Limit Group
rootCause: /api/projects/:projectId/workflows is omitted from 'generate' rate limit list, allowing heavy multi-phase pipelines to execute under high general write limits.

title: BIM Topology Creates Spatial Access Edges for Non-Traversable Service Openings
rootCause: Line 41 treats all non-window openings as traversable spatial access connections, incorrectly including MEP service ducts and crawlspaces in circulation topology.

title: Construction Options Schema Rejects Whole-Integer and Low-Precision Quantities
rootCause: quantityDecimalPlaces enforces min(6), preventing standard discrete unit formatting or whole-number procurement displays.

title: Missing Production Validation for Mandatory PROJECT_COMMIT_SECRET
rootCause: PROJECT_COMMIT_SECRET is optional in EnvSchema without superRefine enforcement in production, allowing silent boots that subsequently crash all project mutations with 503.

title: BIM Core Arbitrarily Restricts Level Footprint Vertex Count to 4 or 6
rootCause: Line 35 restricts storey boundaries strictly to [4, 6] vertices, rejecting valid complex orthogonal building footprints like T-shapes and cross-shapes.

title: Setting Room Count to Zero Corrupts Requirements Schema
rootCause: Line 98 mutates room count to 0 instead of filtering the room from requirements, violating the min(1) schema constraint and falsely reporting an unresolvable user conflict.
